subtitle: A Hilarious Post-Apocalyptic Fantasy RPG Experience
tagline: Grab your dice, assemble a ragtag crew, and brave the hilarious perils of a ruined fantasy world.
loreSummary: Freelancers: A Crossroads Game merges the vibrant storytelling of tabletop roleplaying games with the fast-paced accessibility of a modern board game. Set in a colorful post-apocalyptic fantasy realm where civilization crumbled centuries ago, players embody ambitious freelance mercenaries seeking loot and prestige. Guided by a fully voice-acted digital companion app, you will navigate branching narrative encounters, frantic time-pressured decisions, and hilarious party banter.
keyFeatures: Fully voice-acted companion web app delivering professional audio narration and dynamic encounters
Time-pressured worker placement mechanics requiring quick thinking under ticking timers
Crossroads storytelling system with comedic dilemmas, moral surprises, and unpredictable twists
Zero prep time with intuitive pick-up-and-play character creation and legacy sheets

intro-contract.name: First Contract (Tutorial Job)
intro-contract.description: Introductory freelance contract introducing app audio narration, time-pressured worker placement, and gig scoring.

core-campaign.name: The Big Score Campaign
core-campaign.description: Standard narrative campaign featuring five distinct high-stakes freelance jobs through post-apocalyptic fantasy ruins.

all-contracts.name: All Contracts & Expansion Jobs
all-contracts.description: Complete run playing all included story scenarios with varied character builds and legacy character sheets.

first-payday.title: The First Payday
first-payday.description: Complete your crew's first contract, level up quirky skills, and record titles on your character sheet.

wasteland-notoriety.title: Wasteland Notoriety
wasteland-notoriety.description: Survive bizarre mutant encounters and build the party's infamous reputation among rival guilds.

crossroads-reckoning.title: Crossroads Dilemma
crossroads-reckoning.description: Face difficult moral decisions triggered by Crossroads cards that pit personal greed against party survival.

the-master-heist.title: The Grand Score
the-master-heist.description: Infiltrate a perilous corporate ruin to secure the ultimate treasure trove before the timer expires.

hall-of-legends.title: Hall of Legends
hall-of-legends.description: Calculate lifetime plunder, cement your freelancer titles in folklore, and retire in outrageous luxury.
